tooltip.skycraft.loot.crown_of_barenziah: Restored with all twenty-four stones. Fences pay well for its story; thieves pray to it.
tooltip.skycraft.loot.black_book: Its pages move when no one is looking.
message.skycraft.loot.skill_set: You have read all five books of %s: your understanding deepens.
message.skycraft.loot.black_book_secret: Knowledge of %s floods your mind (+1 perk point)
message.skycraft.loot.black_book_read_ag: The book has nothing more to teach you.
message.skycraft.loot.elder_scroll_read: Visions of what was and what will be burn across your sight... and leave you blind.
The eight masks of the Dragon Cult's priests, taken from their guardians in Skyrim's barrows. Bring them together and the ninth, Konahrik's, answers.
Konahrik's golden mask and a perk point
collection.skycraft.daedric_artifacts.de: Each Daedric Prince keeps a gift for a mortal worthy of it, waiting at their shrines across Tamriel. Prove your worth (and your level) to claim it.
Weapons from Skyrim's songs: Wuuthrad in Ysgramor's Tomb, the Staff of Magnus beneath Labyrinthian, Auriel's Bow beyond Darkfall Cave... and a few that turn up only in the deepest hoards.
Twenty-four unusual gems pried from Queen Barenziah's crown, scattered across Skyrim's dungeons. The Journal names the place each one is hidden.
The Crown of Barenziah, 1,000 gold and a perk point; more gems in every hoard
collection.skycraft.black_books.desc: Seven books of Hermaeus Mora hidden in Solstheim's ruins. Each one read teaches a secret: a perk point and two levels of its skill.
collection.skycraft.elder_scrolls.desc: Fragments of creation itself: the Dragon scroll in Blackreach's Tower of Mzark, the Blood scroll in Dimhollow Crypt, the Sun scroll beyond Darkfall Cave.
collection.skycraft.skill_books.desc: Five books for every skill. Each teaches one level the first time it is read; reading all five of a skill teaches one more.
collection.skycraft.legendary_uniques.de: One-of-a-kind weapons of every province, waiting in named dungeons, forgotten camps and the treasure of their province's bosses.
collectible.skycraft.black_books.winds_o: Black Book: The Winds of Change
collectible.skycraft.elder_scrolls.drago: It tells of the Dragon War, and of a time that was broken.
collectible.skycraft.elder_scrolls.blood: It speaks of a prophecy written in the blood of a vampire lord's daughter.
collectible.skycraft.elder_scrolls.sun.d: It glows faintly, warm as a summer morning, and speaks of Auri-El's light.
collection.skycraft.treasures_skyrim.des: Relics of the Deep Folk's cities under Skyrim: a fence in Riften pays well for the full set. Found in that province's chests and hoards.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_skyrim.dw: A spinning brass core that never quite stops.
A cube of tonal inscriptions; it hums when held near a Dwemer lock.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_skyrim.ae: A sliver of blue crystal that glows with its own light.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_skyrim.dw: Its faces slide, but never into the same pattern twice.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_skyrim.ce: Still warm. Whatever it powered is not.
collection.skycraft.treasures_cyrodiil.d: Treasures of the Heartland Elves from the ruins of Cyrodiil. Found in that province's chests and hoards.
Meteoric glass charged with the light of Aetherius.
A great stone that once lit an Ayleid hall from its ceiling.
A star-shaped stone of raw power, hidden by the Ayleids in their deepest vaults.
Fallen from the sky, worked by Elven hands.
White gold, etched with the name of a forgotten king.
Holy and profane treasures of the Dunmer, from ashlands to tombs. Found in that province's chests and hoards.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_morrowind: A figure of packed ash. The Sixth House left many; few dare keep one.
A small shrine-box for an ancestor's bones, beautifully worked.
Rare, white, and smelling faintly of egg mine.
Almalexia, Sotha Sil and Vivec, painted on an ebony panel.
An instrument for listening to something no one else can hear.
collection.skycraft.treasures_black_mars: Gifts of the Hist and the old Saxhleel kingdoms. Found in that province's chests and hoards.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_black_mar: Hardened Hist sap; something small is caught inside, and it still moves.
A stone tablet from a stepped pyramid, carved in a forgotten script.
A figure carved from a Hist's root, sticky to the touch.
A gilded scale once worn by a ruler of the old marsh.
Woven roots and bones; the Saxhleel tie them over doorways.
collection.skycraft.treasures_elsweyr.de: Sacred things of the Khajiit and their two moons. Found in that province's chests and hoards.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_elsweyr.m: A figure of crystallised moon sugar. Do not lick it.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_elsweyr.l: A silver plate engraved with the dance of Masser and Secunda.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_elsweyr.m: Beads once blessed by a Mane of the Khajiit.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_elsweyr.s: A brass censer for burning sweet offerings to the moons.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_elsweyr.c: An ivory comb, the sign of a clan-mother's authority.
Treasures of the Bosmer, who take nothing from the trees. Found in that province's chests and hoards.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_valenwood: Carved bone, never wood: the Green Pact forbids it.
The seed of a walking city. It is warm, like something living.
A beast-mask from the Wild Hunt. Best not worn.
A quill used by a Spinner to weave the Bosmer's stories.
A hunting horn of the archer-scouts of the Jaqspur.
collection.skycraft.treasures_summerset: Psijic Relics of the Summerset Isles
Treasures of the Altmer and the mysterious Psijic Order. Found in that province's chests and hoards.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_summerset: A token of the Order. It is never quite where you left it.
A shard of the tower that stands for Summerset in the world.
A case of moonstone and gold for an archivist's scrolls.
A lens ground by the scholars of Alinor; through it, letters glow.
A coin older than any empire of men.
collection.skycraft.treasures_hammerfell: Treasures of the Redguards and their lost homeland. Found in that province's chests and hoards.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_hammerfel: The hilt of an ancient blade, wrapped in sharkskin.
A fragment of a spirit sword, the Sword-Singers' greatest art.
A Sword-Singer's ward against the dead.
The snake that eats itself, carved in black stone.
Its sand runs upward at dawn, the nomads say.
Heirlooms of the Bretons' petty kingdoms, their witches, and Orsinium. Found in that province's chests and hoards.
collectible.skycraft.treasures_high_rock: The sigil of the Elven clan that once ruled High Rock.
A witch's doll. Its stitching is far too neat.
From a sacred tree of the Wyrd; it sprouts in no soil you own.
A signet ring of a house that has backed every side of every war.
A carved Orc totem from a stronghold of Wrothgar.
unique.skycraft.red_eagles_fury.lore: The blade of the Reach's last king, still hot with his rage.
unique.skycraft.bloodthorn.lore: A witch's dagger, grown more than forged.
unique.skycraft.nettlebane.lore: Hagravens fear it; their thorns fear it more.
unique.skycraft.gauldur_blackblade.lore: Forged for a son who betrayed his father, and buried with him.
unique.skycraft.ghostblade.lore: It passes through armour as if it were a memory.
unique.skycraft.the_pale_blade.lore: Frost walks with it; the dead of the Pale salute it.
unique.skycraft.kahvozeins_fang.lore: A dagger the Dragon Cult used to take what dragons leave behind.
unique.skycraft.welkynd_sliver.lore: An Ayleid dagger set with a sliver of starlight.
unique.skycraft.goldbrand.lore: A blade of living gold. Kings have killed for it, and been killed by it.
unique.skycraft.umbra.lore: The sword whispers, and those it kills are never quite gone.
unique.skycraft.hopesfire.lore: Twin of Trueflame, made to bring light into dark places.
unique.skycraft.trueflame.lore: The blade of a Dunmer hero, rekindled in the ash.
unique.skycraft.keening.lore: A Dwemer tool for shaping a god's heart. It sings as it cuts.
unique.skycraft.sunder.lore: Keening's partner: a hammer that strikes the heart of creation.
unique.skycraft.riekling_spear_of_thirsk: Taken from the mead hall of Thirsk by a hero of Solstheim.
unique.skycraft.hist_fang.lore: A Saxhleel blade blessed by the sap of the Hist.
unique.skycraft.shadowscale_kris.lore: The wavy blade of Dark Brotherhood assassins of the marsh.
unique.skycraft.marsh_lords_mace.lore: The sceptre of a Lizard King of old, heavy with authority.
unique.skycraft.claw_of_alkosh.lore: A blade of the Dragon King of cats, kept by his warrior-monks.
unique.skycraft.moonblade_of_the_mane.lo: Curved like Secunda, sharp as Masser's light.
unique.skycraft.rajhins_shadow.lore: The bow of a famous thief. It never misses, and never tells.
unique.skycraft.green_pact_fang.lore: A bone dagger. Not a splinter of wood in it.
unique.skycraft.jaqspur_longbow.lore: The bow of Valenwood's elite scouts, strung with spider silk.
unique.skycraft.wild_hunt_axe.lore: Carried by a Bosmer who came back from the Wild Hunt.
unique.skycraft.alinor_dawnblade.lore: Sunlight caught in moonstone, carried by the King's guard.
unique.skycraft.psijic_longbow.lore: Its arrows arrive a heartbeat before they are loosed.
unique.skycraft.sunbird_greatsword.lore: The blade of a Summerset champion, shining like dawn.
unique.skycraft.sword_of_the_ansei.lore: Carried across the sea from lost Yokuda.
unique.skycraft.hews_bane_scimitar.lore: The blade of a pirate-king of Hew's Bane.
unique.skycraft.shehai_blade.lore: A spirit sword made solid, the last work of a Sword-Singer.
unique.skycraft.shornhelm_blade.lore: The sword of Rivenspire's barons, from a time of honest wars.
unique.skycraft.direnni_warhammer.lore: An Elven hammer from the age when the Direnni ruled High Rock.
unique.skycraft.chrysamere.lore: The Paladin's Blade, the sword of heroes in High Rock's legends.
unique.skycraft.gortwogs_hammer.lore: The hammer of the king who rebuilt Orsinium.
unique.skycraft.malacaths_cleaver.lore: An Orc battleaxe blessed in the name of the Furious One.
unique.skycraft.dragonguard_katana.lore: An Akaviri blade of the first Dragonguard.
unique.skycraft.atmoran_frostaxe.lore: Carried by the first men to cross the Sea of Ghosts.
item.skycraft.skill_book_fishing.v3: Nets of the Sea of Ghosts
